Files: src/state_machine.ts, src/config_validator.ts (final/join validation), src/types.ts (final?, isDone surface), README.md + docs/regions-and-parallel.md, .llm-wiki/pages/{regions-and-parallel,entry-exit-ordering,all-final-join}.md, etc/statemachine.api.md (final?, isDone), .changeset/composite-region-final-join.md (MINOR). Tests: src/tests/hierarchical.test.ts + config_validator.test.ts.

TASK-012 was engineering-complete before this session (code committed on branch); it had stalled in CREATIVE because an earlier critic-gate envelope was not captured (the same prose-wrapper hook defect seen repeatedly this session — critics must emit a bare JSON envelope with no surrounding prose). Resolution this session: independent verification workflow (wdjxtj6xy, verdict=implemented/high) cross-checked requirements vs code+test assertions; then materialized the MB3 package, recorded UR/implementation/QA evidence, and drove the formal 4-gate close (Plan Fidelity, Coverage, Sustainability, Honesty). Lessons: (1) a large single-file engine (state_machine.ts ~2400 lines) concentrates region/join semantics — future refactor could extract a region subsystem (F-S-1); (2) public API tested via any-cast relies solely on the api-extractor ratchet (F-COV-2/F-S-2); (3) partial single-region re-entry ordering is timer-asserted but not log-order-asserted (F-COV-1/F-S-3). All advisory LOW, logged for carry-forward.
